concepts.title: SAC-SMA Purpose and Conceptual Model
concepts.description: The Burnash conceptual rainfall-runoff model represents catchment-average water stores and fluxes rather than resolving soil physics point by point.

concepts.title: Soil-Moisture Stores and Evapotranspiration
concepts.description: Upper and lower tension/free-water stores encode distinct access and drainage behavior, with ordered evapotranspiration withdrawals.

concepts.title: Runoff, Percolation, Interflow, and Baseflow
concepts.description: Area fractions, lower-zone deficit, percolation, and recession laws divide water among fast and slow response paths.

concepts.title: Numerical Substeps and Water Balance
concepts.description: Adaptive within-step increments and cumulative water accounting connect daily coefficients to arbitrary driver timesteps and expose numerical defects.

concepts.title: Multiple HRUs and Basin Aggregation
concepts.description: The implementation advances independent parameter/state arrays by HRU and combines outputs with area weights.

concepts.title: Reading Fortran as C, C++, or Python
concepts.description: Modules, derived types, allocatable arrays, INTENT, ASSOCIATE, and one-based loops map to familiar object, ownership, and mutation concepts.

concepts.title: BMI Driver and C/C++ Interoperability
concepts.description: The driver supplies lifecycle control while the Fortran BMI implementation exposes model state through a stable framework-facing contract and an ISO C registration shim.

concepts.title: Build, Test, Diagnose, and Critique
concepts.description: CMake targets, example data, mass-balance evidence, interface contracts, and known source discrepancies support disciplined verification.
